title: Glass-fronted room labelled 'Dream Chamber' with shelving, tables and an air purifier
objects_and_counts: People: no people are visible in the photographed scene.
Shelving: one large white bookshelf unit is visible directly behind the glass; it has multiple horizontal shelves and vertical dividers and occupies much of the left-to-center background.
Books: many individual books are visible on the bookshelf across several shelves; an exact count cannot be determined from the image due to partial obstructions and depth.
Tables: two small round tables are visible in the foreground — one wooden-top table at lower-left and one white-top table at lower-right (the white table is partly cropped by the right image edge).

Seating: at least two stools/ottomans are visible — one green cylindrical ottoman immediately in front of the wooden table (fully visible) and one grey/blue cylindrical stool partially visible at lower-right beside the white table.
Hand sanitizer bottles: two standing pump bottles are clearly visible on horizontal surfaces — one on the wooden table at lower-left and one on the white table at lower-right.

Air purifier (or similar freestanding device): one white upright device with a circular illuminated blue ring is visible on the floor near the right side of the bookshelf; the brand marking 'Philips' is legible on its front panel.
Chairs and work table: a wooden work table with at least two chairs is visible further inside the room, behind the bookshelf toward the center-right.
Whiteboard/easel: one freestanding flip-chart or easel with a whiteboard or paper pad is visible in the mid-right background inside the room.
Additional shelving/cabinet: a smaller white cabinet or shelving unit is visible in the far back corner of the room.

Behind and to the right of the bookshelf is a longer wooden work table with at least two chairs facing it; beyond that, a small cabinet or bookshelves occupy the far corner.
A freestanding easel/whiteboard stands inside the room toward the right side, between the work table area and the glass wall reflection area.
